boards.school_name: The University of Texas at Arlington
boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten documented no-admission activities at UTA and nearby downtown Arlington.

cards.title: See an exhibition at The Gallery at UTA
cards.subtitle: Fine Arts Building, UTA campus
cards.notes: Check the gallery calendar, then enter through the Fine Arts Building’s first-floor north end to view the current show without an admission charge.
cards.short_summary: A campus gallery visit with free, public-facing events.
cards.evidence_claim: UTA states that all Gallery events are free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Located on the first floor at the north end of the Fine Arts Building; parking may require payment.

cards.entity_name: UTA Visiting Artists Program public lectures
cards.title: Attend a Visiting Artists Program lecture
cards.subtitle: Fine Arts Building, UTA campus
cards.notes: Use the program’s schedule to select a public lecture, arrive before the listed start time, and follow any event-specific updates from the department.
cards.short_summary: Public artist talks hosted by UTA’s Art and Art History department.
cards.evidence_claim: UTA says Visiting Artists Program lectures are free, non-ticketed, and open to the general public unless otherwise noted.
cards.access_notes: Confirm the individual lecture’s location and any exception noted on the program page; parking may require payment.

cards.title: Catch an ECA Cinema screening
cards.subtitle: UTA campus
cards.notes: Watch the Student Activities event listings for the next film, then bring a friend for the campus screening and its included popcorn or concessions.
cards.short_summary: A free on-campus movie series presented by EXCEL.
cards.evidence_claim: UTA Student Activities describes ECA Cinema as a free night at the movies on campus and says EXCEL provides free popcorn and concessions.
cards.access_notes: Check the Student Activities calendar for each screening’s date, location, and audience details.

cards.title: Join a Festival of Ideas session
cards.subtitle: UTA campus
cards.notes: Review the Festival of Ideas program when it is announced, choose a talk or performance, and plan to arrive early for the listed campus venue.
cards.short_summary: An annual UTA arts, humanities, and social-sciences program.
cards.evidence_claim: UTA reported that all 2026 Festival of Ideas events were free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: UTA Festival of Ideas explores power of awe
cards.access_notes: The cited 2026 program used the UTA Planetarium and SEIR 298; verify future-program details before going.

cards.title: Experience UTA’s Annual Benefit Powwow
cards.subtitle: Maverick Activities Center, UTA campus
cards.notes: Follow UTA and the Native American Student Association for the next Powwow date, then attend the cultural program when doors open at the MAC.
cards.short_summary: A UTA-hosted gathering with dancers, singers, vendors, and community members.
cards.evidence_claim: UTA reported that its 30th Annual Benefit Powwow was free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: UTA’s 30th powwow honors legacy, celebrates community
cards.access_notes: The cited 2026 event was at the Maverick Activities Center; confirm future event details with the organizers.

cards.title: Hear the Jazz and Commercial Voice Showcase
cards.subtitle: FA 258, Fine Arts Building, UTA campus
cards.notes: Look for the next Music Department showcase, arrive before doors open, and enjoy student vocal performances in the Fine Arts recital hall.
cards.short_summary: A UTA student vocal-performance showcase for the public.
cards.evidence_claim: UTA’s event listing states that the Jazz and Commercial Voice Showcase performance is free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: The cited showcase was in FA 258; food and drink are not permitted in the recital hall except bottled water.

cards.title: Browse Arlington ISD College Night
cards.subtitle: Maverick Activities Center, UTA campus
cards.notes: Drop in to compare college and university information tables, or attend one of the financial-aid presentations held in the MAC’s Lone Star Auditorium.
cards.short_summary: A free college fair held at UTA’s Maverick Activities Center.
cards.evidence_claim: UTA states that Arlington ISD College Night is free and students do not need to register.
cards.access_notes: The listed 2026 event is September 17, 7–9 p.m.; UTA identifies West Campus Garage and Lot 34 for parking.

cards.title: Spread out for a Levitt Pavilion concert
cards.subtitle: Founders Plaza, 100 W. Abram St., Arlington
cards.notes: Check the concert calendar, bring a lawn chair or blanket, and use the open lawn seating for a no-ticket outdoor music night downtown.
cards.short_summary: A downtown outdoor series with dozens of free concerts annually.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Arlington says Levitt Pavilion provides 50 free concerts a year with open lawn seating.
cards.access_notes: Concert dates vary. The venue is in Founders Plaza across from City Hall; bring your own seating.

cards.title: Take in DreamFest at Levitt Pavilion
cards.subtitle: Levitt Pavilion, Downtown Arlington
cards.notes: Plan for the Memorial Day weekend program, bring a blanket or lawn chair, and enjoy the scheduled music and family-oriented activities without admission.
cards.short_summary: A free, family-friendly downtown Arlington Memorial Day weekend celebration.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Arlington describes DreamFest as a free, family-friendly Memorial Day weekend celebration at Levitt Pavilion.
cards.source_title: Enjoy Three Nights of Free Music at 2026 DreamFest May 22-24, 2026
cards.access_notes: The cited 2026 event ran May 22–24; food and vendor purchases were optional, not required for entry.

cards.title: Bring a book to Booked for the Night
cards.subtitle: Levitt Pavilion lawn, Downtown Arlington
cards.notes: Watch Arlington Public Library and Levitt updates for the next program, bring a book or blanket, and settle in for the reading hour and music.
cards.short_summary: A free, family-friendly reading event and concert on the Levitt lawn.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Arlington described Booked for the Night as a free, family-friendly reading event and concert, part of a three-night free program.
cards.source_title: Enjoy Free Movies, Vendor Markets, Music and More This Spring Break
cards.access_notes: The cited program was March 20, 2026; verify whether and when Arlington schedules a future edition.
